usage: “洗衫” (sai2 saam1) is a noun that refers specifically to the activity of washing clothes.
It can be used as a standalone noun or combined with verbs to describe the action related to laundry.
In daily conversation, you can say “我去洗衫” to mean “I am going to wash clothes.”
It is a common household term in Hong Kong Cantonese and is informal and widely understood.
Though primarily a noun, it sometimes appears in verb phrases indicating the entire laundry process.

examples.jyutping: gam1 jat6 ngo5 mou5 si4 gaan3 sai2 saam1.
examples.meaning: I don’t have time to wash clothes today.

examples.meaning: We’ll go to the laundry shop on Saturday.
